719-4477-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-4477-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3532-5078-8346-8348.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Data triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6996-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6996-8319.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

710-728-2730.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Danitha enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

413-4321-4559-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-4321-4559-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Peregrin Took.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

475-5641-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-5641-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2440-5115-7546.description:
Cast Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {U}{R}, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste that enters prepared.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Lizard or Wizard creature you control.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, adding {U/R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 an additional time.
Repeat.
2440-5115-7546.notes: Mana needed drops significantly for each additional creature you control that is a Lizard or Wizard.

1367-4428-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Sanar. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-4428-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

757-950-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

772-891-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

792-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
792-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Totentanz and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1251-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1251-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1432-4639-7014.notablePrerequisites: North Pole Patrol and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
1432-4639-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
North Pole Patrol triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Ioreth of the Healing House triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.

2173-2932-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2173-2932-4050-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
2173-2932-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1978-3789-6893.description:
Animate The Eternity Elevator using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat from step 2.
1978-3789-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

1034-2060-4331.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, ensuring to use four different colors of mana.
Lux Artillery triggers, giving Crystalline Crawler sunburst, causing it to enter with eight +1/+1 counters due to sunburst and its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{W}{U}{U}{B}{R}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2919-4186-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-4186-6097.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1168-1651-4426-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-4426-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1168-1651-4426-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

997-1580-4871-6663.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1339-2122-2265-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-2265-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2468-2751-3401.notablePrerequisites: Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2468-2751-3401.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate any number of artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Blinkmoth Infusion without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.

1251-3204-4364-6188.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1251-3204-4364-6188.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-1506-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Burning Anger attached to Avenging Druid.
224-1506-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

1129-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1129-1909-4486.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.
1129-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

390-1525-2031-2406-2660.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
390-1525-2031-2406-2660.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
390-1525-2031-2406-2660.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

requires.n: Artifact with MV<=2 that has a generic mana cost

1306-1393-2511-4986--31.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Aether Channeler, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

328-338-4499-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
Your devotion to black is at least three, or you have at least two opponents.
328-338-4499-5296.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Workhorse triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black is at least four, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counters on Workhorse and colorless mana.

803-1558-3263-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1558-3263-4302.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Arcane Adaptation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

678-4771-5296.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing itself, targeting Workhorse.
Myr Scrapling dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-2005.notablePrerequisites: Jetfire has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-2005.description:
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {3} and converting it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Cult of the Waxing Moon triggers, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token.
Repeat.

3217-3489-3752.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3217-3489-3752.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When the creature is unblocked, activate Phage's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked creature to your hand, putting Phage onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Phage enters the battlefield, however its ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Deal combat damage with Phage.
Phage triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

176-4050-4509.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-4050-4509.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature, adding one mana of any color.
Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
Repeat.

64-2103-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Warden of the Eye.
64-2103-4305.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
The Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

771-1328.notablePrerequisites: Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
771-1328.description:
Declare the creature with Spellbinder equipped as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
Deal combat damage with the creature, triggering Spellbinder, casting a copy of Savage Beating without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
